note: CEFR defines can-do descriptors, not word lists. Finland's YKI/OPH publishes level descriptions and nine topic categories, not an official A1-C2 vocabulary. All levels in this project are derived in-house and must carry provenance.

sources.name: User-provided workbook: finnish_A1-B1_vocabulary_database.xlsx
sources.license: user-provided; used with the project owner's permission
provides: 116 sentences / fixed expressions / dialogue lines / word examples
sources.caveat: The workbook's own 等级核验 column says 建议等级，非官方逐词CEFR定级 (suggested level, not an official per-word CEFR grading). The workbook has no IPA, English gloss, image, audio, stems, cases or verb principal parts.

sources.name: Kotus Nykysuomen sanalista 2024 / Kielipankki + Enriched Kotus word list (Zenodo)
sources.license: CC BY 4.0 (upstream Kotus CC BY); see NOTICE for the required citation
sources.caveat: Class numbers are hints for the rule engine, not ready-made inflection tables. 800/930 imported lemmas had a class; the rest were derived from word shape or left as paradigm pending. No translations and no CEFR levels.

sources.name: Yle Uutisten taajuussanakirja (Yle Finnish News Archive 2011-2024)
sources.license: CC BY 4.0, Daniel Radice / Yle / Kielipankki
provides: corpus frequency for future grading work
sources.caveat: Reference data only; not yet wired into the level-assignment pipeline.

sources.name: Machine-assisted zh -> en gloss cache with hand-checked overrides
sources.license: derived in-house (MyMemory translation API output, reviewed)
sources.caveat: Generated in batches, cached in the repo so normal builds need no network. 166 verb infinitives are hand-checked because Chinese verb glosses are ambiguous. All generated English is tagged auto-derived in the pack.

sources.name: Wiktionary Finnish declension / conjugation tables (incl. zh.wiktionary)
sources.caveat: Share-alike obligation; no Wiktionary text is redistributed in this pack.

sources.name: Kielipankki corpora / Finnish Wikipedia dump / OPUS subtitles
sources.caveat: Ship derived counts only, never raw corpus text.

sources.name: Opetushallitus YKI framework + Kielitaidon tasojen kuvausasteikko
sources.caveat: Reference only. OPH states there is no official textbook or word list for YKI.

sources.name: Lucide Icons v1.74.0 (lucide-static)
provides: 2401 line-art glyph names used as the depot for semantic SVG illustrations
sources.caveat: Only a curated, depictive subset is used. UI/editor/brand glyphs and modifier variants are excluded. Every card also carries the word's Chinese meaning label, because a single line-art glyph cannot literally depict most abstract words.

sources.name: In-house: 50 demo words / 35 demo sentences, rule-derived morphology, illustrations
sources.caveat: Human QA is our responsibility. All generated illustrations are image_reviewStatus=pending until a person reviews them.

importPolicy.regenerate: node scripts/export-sheets.mjs && node scripts/build-en-glosses.mjs && node scripts/import-a1-b1.mjs && node scripts/generate-illustrations.mjs && node scripts/build-content.mjs && node scripts/build-groups.mjs
importPolicy.reviewStatus: every imported row is auto-derived; all 977 generated illustrations are pending human review, no audio is human-verified
importPolicy.imageStatus: 980 ready illustrations: 977 deterministic 100x100 SVG cards + 3 hand-made PNG samples; 0 pending motif placeholders
importPolicy.audioStatus: 0 clips declared; browser TTS fallback for all items
importPolicy.morphology: IPA, case tables, stems and verb principal parts are derived from Kotus class + word shape by scripts/fi-morphology.mjs. Unresolved words show — and are labelled paradigm pending, never indeclinable unless they genuinely are.
importPolicy.cefr: suggested level copied from the workbook; treated as an in-house product convention only

grading_recipe: suggested level from the workbook (A1 / A2 / B1)
cross-check against Kotus class, verb type 1-6 and morphology complexity
map workbook topic to a YKI topic category via data/topics.json
human spot-check 100 words per level before publishing
forbidden: Scraping FunEasyLearn word lists, illustrations or audio (proprietary)
Using CC BY-NC word lists in a product that may be commercialised
Publishing machine-translated Chinese glosses without human review
Copying commercial blog 'A1 word list' posts (copyrighted content)
Presenting the workbook's suggested levels as an official CEFR / YKI word list
